_meta.description: Formally verified refutation database — financial-engineering claims disproved or confirmed in Lean 4 / Mathlib.
_meta.method: Each refuted claim has a machine-checked counterexample; each confirmed claim has a machine-checked proof.

_refuted.cvar_is_coherent: REFUTED 2026-06-27 - naive tail-integral CVaR fails translation, monotone, subadditive on Fin 3 uniform; use ES (Rockafellar-Uryasev).
_refuted.sharpe_scale_invariant_all_c: REFUTED - false for c<0 (sign flips); Sharpe is only scale-invariant under positive scaling.
_refuted.diversification_always_reduces_variance: REFUTED - positively correlated assets can exceed either individual variance.
_refuted.kelly_maximizes_expected_wealth: REFUTED - Kelly maximizes E[log W], not E[W]; bet-everything dominates E[W] with ruin probability 1.
_refuted.max_sharpe_always_equal_weights: REFUTED - max-Sharpe weights depend on inverse covariance and excess returns; equal weights optimal only under full symmetry.
_refuted.all_martingales_bounded: REFUTED - symmetric random walk is an unbounded martingale (limsup +inf, liminf -inf a.s.).
_refuted.es_symmetric_in_alpha: REFUTED - ES(alpha) != ES(1-alpha) in general; equal only for symmetric zero-mean distributions.
